ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle BAC=90^\circ$, $AB=5\text{cm}$, $BC=13\text{cm}$. Point $D$ is on segment $AC$, and $CD=7\text{cm}$. A moving point $P$ starts from point $E$, which is $15\text{cm}$ away from point $B$, and moves in the direction of ray $EA$ at a speed of $2\text{cm}$ per second, for a time of $t$ seconds. During the motion, is there a moment when $\triangle ABC$ and $\triangle ADP$ are congruent? If yes, please calculate the value of $t$; if no, please explain the reason.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} There exists a moment such that $\triangle ABC$ is congruent to $\triangle ADP$, for the following reasons:\\
$\because$ $\angle DAP=\angle BAC=90^\circ$, and $DA=BA$,\\
$\therefore$ when $AP=AC$, $\triangle ABC\cong \triangle ADP$,\\
$\therefore$ $20-2t=12$ or $2t-20=12$,\\
Solving this, we get $t=\boxed{4}$ or $t=16$,\\
$\therefore$ the values of $t$ that satisfy the conditions are \boxed{4} or \boxed{16}.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, A, B, P, E lie on the same horizontal straight line, in the order A, B, P, E; C, D lie on the vertical line passing through A, with D between A and C; there is a right-angle mark at A, indicating that the horizontal line AB (that is, the line on which AP lies) is perpendicular to the vertical line AC (that is, the line on which AD lies). Therefore ∠BAC=90°, and ∠DAP=90°. Reasoning: It is known that AB=5 cm, BC=13 cm, and △ABC is a right triangle at A, so by the Pythagorean theorem, AC=√(13²-5²)=√144=12 cm. Also because D is on AC and CD=7 cm, AD=AC-CD=12-7=5 cm. Therefore AD=AB=5 cm. If △ABC and △ADP are congruent, from the correspondence of the right angles in the figure, AD can be made to correspond to AB; at this time, the other right-angle side AP also needs to correspond to AC, that is, AP=12 cm. In the figure, E is on the right side of B, and EB=15 cm, AB=5 cm, so EA=EB+BA=15+5=20 cm. P moves from E along the direction of ray EA at 2 cm/s; after t seconds, it has moved 2t cm along this straight line, therefore AP=|20-2t|. Let |20-2t|=12, obtaining 20-2t=12 or 2t-20=12, solving gives t=4 or t=16. Therefore there exist two moments that make △ABC and △ADP congruent.
